package main

import (
	"encoding/json"
	"github.com/ryotapoi/mdhop/internal/core"
	"os"
	"runtime"
	"time"
)

func main() {
	runtime.GC()
	var before, after runtime.MemStats
	runtime.ReadMemStats(&before)
	start := time.Now()
	result, err := core.PlanMoveTemplate(os.Args[1], core.MoveTemplateOptions{From: os.Args[3], Directory: os.Args[3] == "src/", Template: "archive/{client}/{updated:year}/{basename}"}, core.Locations{DBPath: os.Args[2]})
	elapsed := time.Since(start).Seconds()
	runtime.ReadMemStats(&after)
	if err != nil {
		panic(err)
	}
	json.NewEncoder(os.Stdout).Encode(map[string]any{"seconds": elapsed, "allocated_bytes": after.TotalAlloc - before.TotalAlloc, "count": len(result.Moved)})
}
